description: Found in defk-fun (2026-10-15). An if/cond/case that gives one of several arrays keeps only the smallest len_lo of the arms (compiler.ex, the branch merge near 'lens = for v <- vals, do: Facts.len_lo(v)'), never len_lb. So with o carrying len(o) >= 2 * len(a), 'if c, do: alloc(u8, 2 * n + 1), else: o' has no relative fact, and in a reduce body that value makes the accumulator lose the fact (the retry) and o[2 * i] keeps its bounds check. Fix: the merged value keeps a len_lb key that every arm has, with the smallest offset. Test: test/scaled_facts_test.exs regrow kernels written with an if (see the comment there), plus a soundness property.
title: Branch merges drop arrays' relative length facts (len_lb)
